 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Memphis Grizzlies forward Jerami Grant has been ruled out for the remainder of the game against the Golden State Warriors with a left calf injury on Nov. 19.
 Grant made a 3-pointer with 9:34 left in the second quarter. He limped off the floor and went straight back to the locker room after the shot. He was later ruled out before halftime.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Grant has been a key veteran for the Grizzlies. He's averaging 11.1 points and shooting 44.1% on 3-pointers.
 Memphis is starting to lose its rotation wing depth. Scotty Pippen Jr. (back) and GG Jackson (broken left foot) are already out with injuries. 
 Jahmai Mashack, Olivier-Maxence Prosper and Kris Murray are among the players who could see more playing time against the Warriors in Grant's absence.
